finding_revalidation.evidence: profile-store.ts now persists any credential-usability transition for identity-equal profiles. The real-HTTP regression proves VERIFIED -> transport unknown returns CREDENTIAL_RESULT_UNKNOWN without a current success claim, then VERIFIED -> 401 returns and persists UNVERIFIED with null evidence.

verify.ts hashes the complete canonical OpenAPI document after required structural checks. Unit mutations of request body, components, parameters and security all change the digest; integration live schema drift returns OPENAPI_INCOMPATIBLE before writes.

contracts.ts binds every handoff field in authoritySha256 and adds skillTreeSha256. git-authority.ts verifies source and Skill commits, source OpenAPI, exact tracked Skill file set/bytes/modes, package version and tree digest before bearer resolution. Negative tests reject each mismatch before a write.

findings.title: Failed credential revalidation preserves stale VERIFIED authority
findings.observation: The identity-equal branch now persists a candidate whenever credential usability changes, instead of supporting only UNVERIFIED-to-VERIFIED.
findings.trigger: Revalidate a previously VERIFIED profile after the same bearer becomes unknown or is rejected with 401/403.
findings.impact: Resolved: transport unknown returns non-success without a current success claim; authoritative rejection returns and persists UNVERIFIED with evidence cleared.

evidence.description: Exact-head integration verifies VERIFIED -> unknown -> 401 and inspects both returned and persisted status.
storeProfile atomically persists either credential-usability transition while preserving profile identity and revision.

findings.verification: Reviewer-local unit and isolated real-HTTP integration suites pass at the exact head.

findings.title: Incompatible request and response schemas produce the same OpenAPI digest
findings.observation: The compatibility function now returns and hashes the complete canonical document after checking the required LP-03 route and bearer structure.
findings.trigger: Change a consumed request, response, parameter, security declaration, actor field or referenced component while retaining route/status names.
findings.impact: Resolved: any such contract drift changes the digest or is rejected before profile creation or a synthetic write.

evidence.description: Unit tests change request body, components, parameters and security and assert different digests.
The live integration serves a drifted schema and proves OPENAPI_INCOMPATIBLE with zero writes.

findings.verification: Reviewer-local unit and isolated real-HTTP integration suites pass at the exact head.

findings.title: Release and Skill claims are not bound to the local Skill bytes
findings.observation: The initializer now verifies a closed handoff against existing source/Skill commits, source OpenAPI, the canonical repository Skills root, exact tracked local bytes/modes, package version and expected tree digest before reading the credential.
findings.trigger: Supply a nonexistent or wrong source/Skill commit, alternate Skill root, changed file set/bytes/mode/version/tree or tampered handoff field.
findings.impact: Resolved: each mismatch fails closed before credential resolution, profile persistence or synthetic business writes.

evidence.description: assertDeploymentAuthority is called before verifyConnection and resolveCredential and verifies the full Git-backed authority chain.
Integration rejects nonexistent Skill commit, source/OpenAPI mismatch, wrong tree, wrong version and handoff tampering with zero writes.

findings.remediation: Completed in 8a64e50c7f9fa2823ea64fe775e553c4058c55b1 with CI history portability fixes through 08cf79442795b1945b24897c066501002a0bb8e6.
findings.verification: Reviewer-local exact binding and negative authority tests pass; exact-head verify and candidate jobs pass with full history.
